purpose: Evidence pack for the seventh bounded manual review batch. These are proposed relevance decisions only and do not alter the terminal IGOD assessment state or authorize publication.

rows.evidenceAnchor: PM-eBus Sewa guideline: eligible-city challenge, State/ULB proposal, CESL demand aggregation, procurement and contract route; the source is hosted by the MoHUA portfolio and department-level ownership requires confirmation
rows.rationale: The evidence supports a business-relevant urban-transport route, but it does not by itself prove that the IGOD-listed DCD record is the responsible authority. Human review must confirm the organizational mapping or record an exclusion.

rows.authorityName: Department of Defence Research and Development (DRDO)
rows.evidenceAnchor: DRDO startup-support page: Technology Development Fund and related defence-technology development routes for startups and MSMEs
rows.rationale: The department publishes defence innovation, prototype, testing and startup/MSME technology-development routes directly relevant to eligible technology businesses.

rows.evidenceAnchor: India Post franchise page: prescribed application, local postal-division selection, franchise route and current business-service navigation
rows.rationale: The department publishes franchise and postal-agent routes relevant to self-employed operators and small businesses, subject to local availability and official selection.

rows.authorityName: Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR)
rows.evidenceAnchor: DSIR PRISM programme page: innovation support for individuals, start-ups and MSMEs, support tracks, notified route and successor/current-call verification boundary
rows.rationale: The department publishes R&D, innovation, commercialization and technology-support routes directly relevant to innovators, startups and MSMEs.

rows.authorityName: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes page: eligible entrepreneurs, lender-led guarantee route, ownership/control conditions and implementing path; department/ministry ownership requires confirmation
rows.rationale: The evidence supports a business-relevant targeted credit route, but the same portal is also mapped to the ministry-level authority. Human review must confirm the correct IGOD owner before counting coverage.

rows.evidenceAnchor: PM-eBus Sewa official portal: scheme overview, notices, city/tender progress and implementation updates; department-level ownership requires confirmation
rows.rationale: The evidence supports an urban-transport market-access route, but it does not establish that DUD, rather than the MoHUA ministry or another implementing body, owns the opportunity.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Official Ministry of Education portal baseline: authority scope and current notices; no specific business-opportunity record is asserted from this homepage alone
rows.rationale: The authority must be crawled for incubator, innovation, skilling, research-commercialization or procurement routes before relevance can be decided. The homepage is evidence of the official source boundary, not evidence of catalog completeness.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Official Ministry of Health and Family Welfare portal baseline: authority scope and current notices; no specific business-opportunity record is asserted from this homepage alone
rows.rationale: The authority must be crawled for health-sector procurement, innovation, research-commercialization, licensing or facility-support routes before relevance can be decided. The homepage does not prove that no business-relevant opportunities exist.
